Retry-After.description: Whole seconds to wait before retrying. Never on quota_exceeded.

X-Request-Id.description: The request's ID, in every log line and its Trails event.

Cursor.description: The previous page's nextCursor. Bound to the organization, the list and its filters.
Cursor.name: cursor

IdempotencyKey.description: Makes a retry safe: the same key and request get the stored response.
IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key

IfMatch.description: * or the route table's ETags read (its routes' revision), comma-separated; optional. A stale one is 412 precondition_failed.
IfMatch.name: If-Match

Limit.description: The page size. Out of range is 400, never a clamp.
Limit.name: limit

AccessDenied.description: access_denied: the caller's policies don't allow the action; forbidden_origin: a cookie-authenticated write from an origin that isn't allowed; spend_limit_reached.

Conflict.description: quota_exceeded (an allocation quota, with quota), idempotency_conflict, idempotency_in_progress (with Retry-After), organization_deletion_pending, operation_in_progress, or the endpoint's own 409 codes.

InternalError.description: internal_error: a bug; the details are in the logs, under the request ID.

InvalidRequest.description: invalid_request (with issues), invalid_cursor, or the endpoint's own 400 codes.

NotFound.description: not_found: unknown, malformed, or in an organization the caller isn't in.

PayloadTooLarge.description: payload_too_large: the body is over the endpoint's limit (1 MiB unless it says otherwise).

TooManyRequests.description: too_many_requests, with Retry-After; or quota_exceeded (a rate, usage or concurrency quota, with quota), never with Retry-After.

Unauthenticated.description: unauthenticated: no credential, or one that doesn't check out.

Unavailable.description: unavailable: a dependency the request needs is down. Retry after Retry-After.

Error.description: Every non-2xx answer. Clients branch on code, never on message.

issues.description: invalid_request: one entry per problem, at a dotted path.

privateIpv4Address.description: On a private interface, the private IPv4 the address is mapped onto (the interface's primary private address, the one the guest sees); null on a public interface.

allowReassociation.description: Move the address if it's associated with another interface.

networkInterface.description: The network interface's eni_ ID (a UUID is 400 invalid_request).

NetworkGateway.description: A Network Gateway: the internet path of the VPC it is attached to.

vpc.description: The VPC it is attached to (vpc_…), null while detached.
The VPC's ID (vpc_…), in the gateway's project.

NetworkInterface.description: A network interface: public, with its own routed IPv6 /64, or private, in a VPC's subnet (subnet set).

ipv6Address.description: <prefix>::1; on a private interface its primary ULA /128 address.

ipv6Prefix.description: The routed public /64. Always set on a public interface; on a private one only when it holds one (through its VPC's network gateway), null otherwise.

mtu.description: 1500 for a public interface, 8900 (read-only) for a private one.

privateAddressAssignments.description: Every realized private address, primaries first, then by family and address; [] on a public interface.

generation.description: The address's ownership generation, a decimal string (the compare-and-swap value of address operations).

privateIpv4Address.description: A private interface's primary IPv4 address, fixed for its life; null on a public one (and while creating).

privatePrefixAssignments.description: Every realized delegated prefix, by family and address; [] on a public interface.

publicIpv6Address.description: <ipv6Prefix>::1, null without a /64. On a private interface: the public IPv6 its /64 gives the guest (ipv6Address stays its ULA).

secondaryPrivateIpv4Addresses.description: Realized secondary IPv4 addresses; [] on a public interface.

secondaryPrivateIpv6Addresses.description: Realized secondary IPv6 addresses; [] on a public interface.

sourceDestCheck.description: With false, a private interface may send packets whose source isn't its own and receive packets routed to it that aren't addressed to it (an appliance a route table targets). Always true on a public interface.

subnet.description: A private interface's subnet (sbn_…), fixed for its life; null on a public one.

vpc.description: A private interface's VPC (vpc_…); null on a public one.

firewalls.description: Omitted: the project's default firewall (with subnet, the VPC's default firewall). []: none.

items.description: A firewall's fwl_ ID (a UUID is 400 invalid_request at this item).

ipv4.description: A public interface: {allocate: true} or {address: "pip_…"}. A private interface (subnet set): {allocate: true|false}, a public IPv4 mapped onto its primary private address (the guest sees only the private one); omitted, the subnet's autoAssignPublicIpv4 decides. Allocating needs an attached network gateway on the VPC (409 vpc_has_no_gateway).

address.description: The address's pip_ ID (a UUID is 400 invalid_request).

ipv6.description: With subnet only (a public interface always has its /64; 400 invalid_request otherwise): a public IPv6 /64 the guest configures beside its ULA; omitted, the subnet's autoAssignPublicIpv6 decides. Allocating needs an attached network gateway (409 vpc_has_no_gateway); 409 ipv6_pool_exhausted as a public create.

privateIpv4Address.description: With subnet: the primary IPv4 address (a usable address of the subnet); omitted, the lowest free one, or one released over an hour ago.

subnet.description: Makes the interface private, in this subnet of the project (another project's is 404). Not taken with ipv4.

sourceDestCheck.description: The source/destination check (default true). false only on a private interface (400 on a public one).

address.description: An address of the interface's subnet, in canonical form; omit it for the next eligible one.
The address, or a delegated prefix in CIDR form.

destinationInterface.description: The interface the address goes to (eni_…); null on unassign.

error.description: On failed: the standard error's inner {code, message}.

expectedGeneration.description: The request's expectedGeneration; null on assign.

generation.description: The address's next ownership generation, reserved when the request was accepted.

sourceInterface.description: The interface the address leaves (eni_…); null on assign.

expectedGeneration.description: The address's generation (privateAddressAssignments), a decimal string.
The address's generation (privateAddressAssignments), a decimal string.

prefix.description: An aligned IPv4 /28 or IPv6 /80 of the interface's subnet, in canonical form; omit it for a free one.

expectedGeneration.description: The prefix's generation (privatePrefixAssignments), a decimal string.

prefix.description: The prefix, as privatePrefixAssignments shows it.

QuotaExceeded.description: quota_exceeded: the quota that refused the request. Never with Retry-After.

window.description: rate only: an ISO 8601 duration, PT1S to PT1H.

state.description: active, or blackhole when the target is deleted, not attached to an instance, or (a gateway) not attached to this VPC.

destination.description: A canonical CIDR (host bits zero). Inside the VPC's ranges it must be exactly one subnet's CIDR (never the VPC's own range) and target a network interface; it may not equal or lie inside 169.254.0.0/16 or fd65:7a67:6800::/48.

state.description: Ignored: a PUT may echo the routes exactly as GET shows them. Refused elsewhere.

id.description: The VPC's attached network gateway (ngw_…), or a private network interface in the VPC (eni_…); null for local.

type.description: local only in a PUT, echoing a local route as GET shows it.

RouteTable.description: A VPC route table: the routes a subnet's traffic takes.

main.description: The VPC's main table, used by every subnet without an explicit table.

routes.description: Local routes first, then by family, prefix length (longest first) and address.

subnets.description: The subnets that use this table (sbn_…), explicitly or, for the main table, by default.

id.description: The target's ID (ngw_…, eni_…); null for local.

type.description: local, networkGateway or networkInterface. An open set: more types may be added, so treat an unknown one as displayable.

destinations.description: Destination CIDRs; an absent one is ignored.

autoAssignPublicIpv4.description: An interface created in the subnet without ipv4 allocates a public IPv4 mapped onto its private address (the VPC needs an attached network gateway).

autoAssignPublicIpv6.description: An interface created in the subnet without ipv6 allocates a public IPv6 /64 (the VPC needs an attached network gateway).

availableIpv4Addresses.description: Addresses free for interfaces: the range less its five reserved addresses, live allocations and addresses still being withdrawn.

routeTable.description: The subnet's effective route table (rtb_…): its explicit one, else the VPC's main table.

ipv4Cidr.description: A canonical IPv4 CIDR, /8 to /28, inside the VPC's range.

autoAssignPublicIpv4.description: The subnet's launch default for a mapped public IPv4; existing interfaces are untouched.

autoAssignPublicIpv6.description: The subnet's launch default for a public IPv6 /64; existing interfaces are untouched.

routeTable.description: Associates the subnet with a route table of its VPC (rtb_…; needs network.routeTables.associate on it), or null for the VPC's main table. Refused with 409 route_table_conflict when the table routes the subnet's CIDR or targets an interface in it.

Tags.description: At most 50; keys 1-128 characters, values at most 256, keys starting with ezgh: are reserved.

failureReason.description: Why a create or delete couldn't finish yet; null otherwise. The recovery pass keeps retrying. vpc_in_use: a delete removed the default firewall while the VPC had subnets; it stays deleting until they are deleted and the VPC is deleted again. addresses_withdrawing: the delete is done but addresses of deleted network interfaces are still being withdrawn from hosts; the VPC is removed once that finishes, with nothing more to do.

apiKey.description: A customer API key: Bearer ezgh_…

oauth.description: An OAuth access token (Bearer ezgh_at_…) or an EZGH SSO resource token (Bearer ezgh_sat_…)

sessionCookie.description: A signed-in person's session, set by login.ezghcloud.com.
sessionCookie.name: __Secure-better-auth.session_token

post.description: An IPv4 /28 or IPv6 /80 from the interface's own subnet, for addresses the instance routes itself: the prefix given, or a free aligned one. The operation's address holds the prefix in CIDR form, and it succeeds once the interface's host is programmed. Requires an Idempotency-Key (1–200 characters); a retry with it answers the same operation as it is now. 400 invalid_request for a wrong length, a prefix not aligned or outside the subnet, or one overlapping a subnet's reserved addresses. Refused with 409 public_interface, interface_not_available, migration_in_progress, host_unsupported and private_address_limit_exceeded (at most 16 IPv4 and 2 IPv6 prefixes per interface; a VPC's addresses, prefixes and interfaces total at most 5,000); 409 address_in_use for a prefix overlapping any address, prefix or VIP, and 409 prefix_unavailable when no aligned block is free.
